change: Only lagged real price growth removed (phi=0); lagged inventory retained.
noar_fit: Full-rank ordinary least squares; AR references retain original nonlinear latent-AR estimation.
market_partial_r2: 1-SSE(full sales+stock model)/SSE(same event and AR specification without sales and stock); descriptive incremental fit, not causal attribution.
forecast: Same as direct-sales experiment: unknown future sales held at six-month mean known at origin; stock held at origin; actual future CPI; future policy events not supplied.
limits: Current sales endogenous; short revised history and retrospective events; overlapping horizons, all annual windows include events.
